query: select jsonb_build_object('capturedAt',clock_timestamp(),'requests',(select jsonb_agg(t) from(select request_kind,match_state,status,count(*) total from public.business_requests group by request_kind,match_state,status)t),'public_businesses',(select count(*) from public.merchants where permanent_listing=true and directory_status='active'),'active_offers',(select count(*) from public.catalogue_items where active),'grades',(select jsonb_agg(t) from(select quality_grade,count(*) total from catalogue_items where active group by quality_grade)t),'photo_holds',(select count(*) from catalogue_items where active and metadata->>'image_review_hold' is not null),'photo_hold_featured',(select count(*) from catalogue_items where active and metadata->>'image_review_hold' is not null and (featured or hot)),'suppression',(select jsonb_agg(t) from(select reason,count(*) total from public.outreach_suppression group by reason)t),'claims',(select count(*) from public.merchant_claims),'policy_commitments',(select sum(commitments_flagged) from public.business_requests),'social_cron_active',(select active from cron.job where jobid=1)) result;
notes: Counts are observed production aggregates, not evidence of consent or completed onboarding.
Six branch-confirmed opt-outs include two matched existing public businesses and four absent-business exclusion records; another six exact recipients await branch matching.
The two reconciled delivery notices remain suppressed; inbox-full was reclassified as temporary capacity failure. Registry invalid count is not a newly reverified bounce count.
No production bookings, holds, claims, messages or social publications were created by this QA.
